notes:
## Changes

- Watch on phone works much better on a tablet. Held sideways, a scene shows its picture next to its title, Play and details, so you can start it without scrolling. A play button sits on the picture.
- A scene's five frames now sit under its picture. Tap one to play from that point.
- The search box shares a row with the title on tablets, leaving more room for covers. Downloads and Drives sit apart, under "On the PC".
- A new "This phone" / "This tablet" button holds the settings for that device: Only show what plays here, Lighter playback, and Disconnect. When something is hidden, the count line says so.
- Performers, Studios, Tags, Downloads and Drives use two columns on wide screens.
- Inside a folder, scene cards show the resolution and rating instead of repeating the folder's name.
- Buttons, check boxes and the A–Z letters are bigger on touch screens.

## Fixes

- Portrait screenshots are no longer cropped on phones and tablets. They're fitted inside the picture area, with black bars at the sides.
- The "Running low" warning on Drives is red again.
linuxNotes:
First Linux preview of Video Shelf: the whole app on Ubuntu and similar systems (.deb). It uses the same catalogue as the Windows app.

Install with:

    sudo apt install ./videoshelf_0.12.0_amd64.deb
